{{pkmn|Masters EX}} |leader=no |brain=Pt |facility={{gdis|Battle Factory|IV}} |print=Factory Print |anime=no |epnum= |epname= |enva= |java= |gameanim=yes |envagame=Jon Allen[https://twitter.com/kingjonallen/status/1167186558203518977 Jon Allen on Twitter] ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) |javagame=Shōhei Komatsu[https://twitter.com/shohei_k0414/status/1168033746127245313 Shōhei Komatsu on Twitter] (Japanese) ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) |pv=yes |pvnum=Pokémon Masters Animated Trailer |pvname=Pokémon Masters Animated Trailer }} '''Thorton''' (Japanese: '''ネジキ''' ''Neziki'') is the [[Frontier Brain]] in charge of running the {{Gdis|Battle Frontier|IV}}'s {{gdis|Battle Factory|IV}}, acting under the title of '''{{tc|Factory Head}}''' (Japanese: '''ファクトリーヘッド''' ''Factory Head''). ==In the core series games== Thorton is the [[Frontier Brain]] of the Battle Factory in the [[Sinnoh]] and [[Johto]] regions. It is suggested he is very intelligent, as he mentions inventing a machine that analyzes the player's Pokémon. If he is defeated he will hand over the Factory Print. ===Pokémon=== Thorton uses three Pokémon from this list: :[[List of Battle Frontier Pokémon in Generation IV/Group 2]] These Pokémon have fixed IVs of 12 when fought as the 21st battle of the streak and IVs of 31 when fought as the 49th battle of the streak. * If Thorton appears as the 21st battle of a streak, his Pokémon are selected from the first listed variant of the species. Thorton will not use any [[Legendary Pokémon]]. * If Thorton appears as the 49th battle of a streak, his Pokémon are selected from the fourth listed variant of the species. [[Legendary Pokémon]] may be any variant. Due to a bug in all Japanese and English versions of {{g|Platinum}}, Thorton will incorrectly use the opposite battle set for the 49th battle of the Lv. 50 challenge and the 21st battle of the Open Level challenge.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wNg5DrO9wOI Pokémon Platinum's Battle Factory is GLITCHED in English] This issue is not present in all other language versions of Platinum, nor any language of {{g|HeartGold and SoulSilver}}. ==In the spin-off games== ===[[Pokémon Masters EX]]=== {{main|Thorton (Masters)}} Thorton forms a [[sync pair]] with {{p|Bronzong}}, {{p|Magnezone}}, and {{p|Regigigas}} in [[Pokémon Masters EX]]. Thorton became a playable sync pair since the game's release. {{PairDex/h|Factory}} {{PairDex|036|Thorton|trainerlink=Thorton (Masters)#Bronzong|trainerimg=Thorton|0437|Bronzong|Steel|Fire|Tech|4EX|Sync Pair Scout}} {{PairDex|036|Thorton|trainerlink=Thorton (Masters)#Magnezone|trainerimg=Thorton|0462|Magnezone|Steel|Fighting|Field|exrole=Support|6|Variety Sync Pair Scout}} {{PairDex|036|Thorton|trainerlink=Thorton (Masters)#Regigigas|trainerimg=Thorton|0486|Regigigas|master=yes|Normal|Fighting|Support|6|Battle Points}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Thorton/Quotes}} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Thorton Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Thorton in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] Thorton first appears along with his fellow [[Frontier Brain]]s, [[Palmer]], [[Dahlia]], and [[Argenta]] in a meeting; afterward they go back to their facilities. Thorton later appears at his facility, the {{gdis|Battle Factory|IV}}, where he watches {{adv|Platinum}} battle through it. Eventually, Platinum manages to get enough wins to allow her to challenge him and they begin battling. Due to the rules of the Battle Factory, the two use [[rental Pokémon]] to Battle each other instead of their own Pokémon. Despite Thorton having much confidence in his battling skills and knowledge, Platinum proves superior to him in both categories, allowing her to defeat him. Angered at his defeat, Thorton throws a temper tantrum until Argenta snaps him out of it by slapping him in the face. Later, he is given a Team Galactic camera robot that [[Riley]] obtained on [[Iron Island]] and is tasked with fixing it. Eventually, he succeeds, but is left exhausted in the process. ====Pokémon==== =====Rented===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Thorton |pkmn=Tyranitar |type1=Rock |type2=Dark |img=Thorton Tyranitar Adventures.png |epnum=PS427 |epname=Uprooting Seedot |desc=Thorton's {{p|Tyranitar}} was used to battle Platinum at the {{gdis|Battle Factory|IV}}. It proved powerful and its ability to create a sandstorm which made Platinum's Pokémon constantly take damage. Eventually, it was defeated by a double supereffective {{m|Focus Punch}} from Platinum's {{pkmn2|rental}} {{p|Kadabra}}. None of Tyranitar's moves are known and its Ability is {{a|Sand Stream}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Thorton |pkmn=Ledian |type1=Bug |type2=Flying |img=Thorton Ledian Adventures.png |epnum=PS427 |epname=Uprooting Seedot |desc=Thorton's {{p|Ledian}} was used to battle Platinum at the {{gdis|Battle Factory|IV}}. It managed to defeat Platinum's {{p|Loudred}} and helped Thorton's Ursaring by sending its stat upgrades to it. Eventually, it was defeated by the {{status|poison}}ing it received from the {{a|Poison Point}} of Platinum's {{p|Qwilfish}}. Ledian's known moves are {{m|Supersonic}}, {{m|Focus Punch}}, {{m|Agility}}, and {{m|Baton Pass}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Thorton |pkmn=Ursaring |type1=Normal |img=Thorton Ursaring Adventures.png |epnum=PS428 |epname=Outlasting Ledian |desc=Thorton's {{p|Ursaring}} was used to battle Platinum at the {{gdis|Battle Factory|IV}}. With the {{stat|speed}} gained from Ledian's Baton Pass, it was able to easily defeat Platinum's rental Qwilfish. Later, it fought her rental Kadabra and was defeated when its energy was absorbed with a {{m|Drain Punch}}.
